versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Awesome OpenClaw Skills Directory.
- Lets users discover, search, and install from over 5,400 curated OpenClaw skills in 30 categories.
- Provides recommendations, installation instructions, and security best practices.
- Includes guidance for using ClawHub CLI, manual installation, and quick chat installs.
- Warns users about security considerations when installing community-built skills.
